content.text: Based on my review of all changed files and their downstream flows: **Review summary:** 1. **`components/closet/item-card.tsx`** — Adds `loading="lazy"` and `decoding="async"` to an `` element. `src`/`alt` attributes are React-rendered (auto-escaped). No new sinks; the signed-URL flow was pre-existing. No security impact. 2. **`lib/generator/rerank.ts`** — Replaces `z.string().max(24)` (which threw) with a `.transform(clampName)` that truncates on a word boundary at 40 chars. `clampName` handles all edge cases safely (`lastSpace > 0` fallback, `trimEnd`). The `name` field originates from Anthropic's response and flows only to `` and `` as plain React text — no innerHTML/eval/HTML-attribute-injection sinks. The prompt string interpolation of `NAME_MAX` (a numeric constant literal) is safe. No security impact. 3. **`supabase/config.toml`** — Local dev section rename `[inbucket]` → `[local_smtp]`. This is a local email testing server for the dev CLI only; production email delivery is governed by the (still-commented) `[auth.email.smtp]` block and unaffected. No security-sensitive setting changed (no auth toggle, RLS setting, or CORS entry moved). No security impact. 4. **Test files** — no runtime code path. No source→sink path with meaningful attacker leverage was introduced.
